note: Menu Item Fields UI is the build-time submodule of menu_item_fields. On enable, hook_entity_type_alter sets menu_link_content's field_ui_base_route to entity.menu.collection, and a RouteSubscriber defaults the bundle route param to menu_link_content on the Field UI / display / field-group routes (single-bundle entity). It provides the Field UI for building fields on menu links (entity_type=menu_link_content, bundle=menu_link_content). Depends on menu_item_fields + field_ui; no config/permission/Drush/plugin of its own. Medium/hard cases introspect the field_ui_base_route and create namespaced fields (field_miu_*) on menu_link_content.

evals.prompt: In the menu_item_fields project, what does the menu_item_fields_ui submodule add, and which entity's field_ui_base_route does it set (and to what route)?
evals.expected_output: It adds the Field UI (Manage fields / form & view displays) for the menu_link_content entity. hook_entity_type_alter sets menu_link_content's field_ui_base_route to entity.menu.collection so the Field UI local tasks attach under the Menus admin area.

evals.prompt: When I add a field through menu_item_fields_ui, what entity type and bundle does it live on?
evals.expected_output: Fields live on the menu_link_content entity type, bundle menu_link_content (a single-bundle entity). The submodule's RouteSubscriber defaults the bundle route parameter to menu_link_content on the field/display routes.

evals.prompt: What does menu_item_fields_ui depend on, and is it meant to stay enabled in production?
evals.expected_output: It depends on menu_item_fields and field_ui. Like core Field UI, you enable it to build fields/form modes/view modes for menu links and can disable it in production afterward; the fields and configuration remain.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, menu_item_fields_ui is enabled. Inspect the menu_link_content entity type definition and report the value of its field_ui_base_route.
evals.expected_output: menu_link_content's field_ui_base_route is entity.menu.collection (set by menu_item_fields_ui's hook_entity_type_alter).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, a field has been created on menu links (menu_link_content) via Field UI. Inspect the live configuration and give the machine name of that field.
evals.expected_output: The field is field_miu_known: a FieldConfig menu_link_content.menu_link_content.field_miu_known with a matching field storage.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site (menu_item_fields_ui is enabled), add a string field with machine name field_miu_task to menu links (the menu_link_content entity). Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Create a FieldStorageConfig (entity_type menu_link_content, field_name field_miu_task, type string) and a FieldConfig on bundle menu_link_content. Verify checks FieldConfig menu_link_content.menu_link_content.field_miu_task exists.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, add a string field field_miu_desc to menu links (menu_link_content) AND make it appear on the menu link default edit form (its default form display). Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Create the field_miu_desc storage + FieldConfig on menu_link_content, then set it as a component on entity_form_display menu_link_content.menu_link_content.default and save. Verify checks that default form display has a field_miu_desc component.
